user.title: 2N Intercom Setup
user.description: Enter the IP address and API credentials of your 2N Intercom. The connection protocol is detected automatically.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the intercom (e.g., 192.0.2.100)
data_description.username: Device login username for API access

device.title: 2N Intercom Setup - Device
device.description: Configure device features. Relays can be configured later in the integration options.

data_description.name: Displayed name in Home Assistant
data_description.enable_camera: Create the camera entity for snapshots and streaming
data_description.enable_doorbell: Create the doorbell entity for ring detection
data_description.called_id: Select which account should ring. Choose All calls to ring on every button.
data_description.go_back: Enable this option and submit the form to go back. Entered values are kept as a draft; nothing is saved yet.

reconfigure.title: 2N Intercom - HTTP API connection
reconfigure.description: Change the intercom address and HTTP API account. These credentials are separate from the camera's RTSP account. Configure the account on the intercom under Services > HTTP API.

reauth_confirm.title: 2N Intercom - HTTP API authentication
reauth_confirm.description: Update the HTTP API credentials for {host}. Do not enter the separate RTSP streaming credentials here.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device. Please check the IP address, port, and credentials.
error.invalid_auth: HTTP API authentication failed. Check the account credentials and permissions on the intercom.

abort.already_configured: This 2N Intercom device is already configured.

device.title: 2N Intercom Options - Device
device.description: Update device features. Camera and detected relays follow in the next steps. To change the HTTP API username, password or address, close this dialog and use the integration entry's three-dot menu > Reconfigure. HTTP API credentials are not the RTSP camera credentials.

data_description.name: Displayed name in Home Assistant
data_description.scan_interval: Backup polling interval (2-600 s). Events deliver real-time updates; polling only runs as a safety net. Default 60 s is fine for most setups.
data_description.called_id: Select which account should ring. Choose All calls to ring on every button.

camera.title: 2N Intercom Options - Camera
camera.description: Tune how Home Assistant streams video from the 2N camera. Lower MJPEG resolution and frame rate dramatically reduce bandwidth on continuously visible dashboards.

data_description.live_view_mode: auto picks RTSP when RTSP credentials are configured and valid, then MJPEG, then JPEG snapshots only
data_description.camera_source: Which sensor on the device to stream — internal is the built-in lens; external is a secondary camera module if fitted
data_description.mjpeg_width: Width of the MJPEG stream requested from the device (e.g. 640)
data_description.mjpeg_height: Height of the MJPEG stream requested from the device (e.g. 480)
data_description.mjpeg_fps: Frames per second for the MJPEG stream (1-15)
data_description.rtsp_username: Username for the 2N RTSP streaming service (configured separately from the HTTP API in the device web UI under Services > Streaming)
data_description.rtsp_password: Password for the RTSP streaming service account
data_description.go_back: Enable this option and submit the form to go back. Entered values are kept as a draft; nothing is saved yet.

relay.title: 2N Intercom Options - Relay {relay_number}
relay.description: Override settings for auto-detected relay {relay_number}. Door strikes typically need ~2000 ms pulse, swing-gate triggers ~15000 ms.

data_description.relay_number: Physical relay number on the device (auto-detected)
data_description.relay_name: Displayed name for this relay in Home Assistant
data_description.relay_device_type: Door creates a switch entity, gate creates a cover entity
data_description.relay_pulse_duration: Trigger pulse length sent to the relay (ms). Default is the device-configured switchOnDuration.
data_description.go_back: Enable this option and submit the form to go back. Entered values are kept as a draft; nothing is saved yet.
